guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows a massive latency spike in emailservice (z=+902.94) alongside a runbook match for conntrack exhaustion, which causes dropped connections. This socket-level bottleneck cascades through checkoutservice and paymentservice, triggering the frontend errors and high tail latencies observed in the traces.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max kernel parameter on the affected node or restart the node to flush stale connections.
